summary: The 2026-10-29 12:06 UTC programme report records a first production-entry refusal whose original comparison operands were unavailable, requiring further source preparation and diagnostic review. A later snapshot cannot reconstruct the vanished original. Preserve the exact failed comparison and bounded sanitized actual/expected operands at the first refusal; diagnostic, collection or cleanup failure must remain secondary to the original outcome. The same report records missed source/diagnostic estimates and an outgoing-ID mailbox filter that omitted a clarification. Reconcile complete relevant new and edited reply bodies before preparing alternate work, and distinguish receipt time from realistic source/result estimates. Fresh original acceptance also avoided repeating portable publication, SC2 storage setup and telemetry settlement. Existing handoff guidance already separates observed/reported/inferred facts, owner actions and receipt/result contracts; these findings refine that existing route rather than justify another owner, ledger, fixed polling cadence or gate. These are observed process lessons and proposed guidance corrections, not proof of runtime repair, installed instruction adoption, efficiency improvement or released holds. Current token costs and savings remain unmeasured.
title: First-failure operands and complete reply reconciliation prevent repeated preparation
